name: Trubblx Ikigai
description: Trubblx Ikigai is an AI-powered sanctuary for self-discovery. It orchestrates a rhythmic dialogue using Gemini AI to help users navigate the four pillars of Ikigai—Passion, Mission, Vocation, and Profession—uncovering their unique reason for being through mindful reflection, interactive diagramming, and actionable purpose blueprints.
